title: docs/test.md: the Windows TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP limit of 43 applies only to wrapper runs with a run-* folder
outcome: docs/test.md says TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP can be at most about 43 bytes under the launcher and 54 for a direct Cargo run. The 43 applies only when the Rust temp wrapper (scripts/test-rust.sh) adds a run-* folder. A focused `-- cargo test` launcher run bypasses that wrapper and has the 54-byte limit, like plain Cargo. Name the wrapper in the limit, and include focused Cargo runs in the unwrapped case, so operators can choose a valid path. Found by the Codex reviewer in round 3 (delegation-8cbb4084-c485-4e69-b2e2-1a8d1b905fb9) of the fixture-budget review; Low.
acceptance: docs/test.md: the Windows TERMAL_TEST_USER_TEMP limit of 43 applies only to wrapper runs with a run-* folder is done
